tools.name: open
tools.description: Use this when the person wants a document, notes, a list, a table, a diagram they can drag to rearrange or a drawing that they can keep editing by hand, or asks to open or continue one. Use this too when they want to paint in watercolor or learn it: the paint is simulated, so pigment flows, mixes, b

tools.name: read
tools.description: Use this before you change a Rapier document, and when the person asks what it says or what they changed. Read exact text, a heading/fence map (as:"outline") or a PNG (as:"image") of the page or of the named block, heading or lines; a drawing's block gives it at full detail, even while it is open in

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Use this to change a document the person is working on in Rapier: the change shows at once, marked as yours, and undoes alone. Apply unique exact-text changes atomically as one undoable act (act is its id string), rename with filename, or set Note fields with note. At a moved numeric revision, liter

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Use this when the person wants a change of yours in Rapier taken back. Undo one act or one turn (act or turn_id, not both), preserving later work.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Use this to point the person to a place in their Rapier document, ask them something there, or pair their browser with a 4-letter code. Present work or ask the person. An omitted target is inferred from its fields. A 4-letter browser code pairs that editor (target:"pair"); a connected workspace's ow

tools.name: export
tools.description: Use this when the person wants their Rapier document as a file to keep: Markdown, Word, PDF, plain text, or one HTML file that opens and edits offline. to:"file" (default) delivers markdown, html, page, txt, docx or pdf (html is the whole editor with the document inside, editable offline); to:"save"

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Use this when the person wants pictures converted to JPEG XL, or JPEG XL pictures converted back. Free, on the person's own device. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "read" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.
